body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Garden Drive disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Residents of Stonebridge said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the strcet. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
